label: misaligned
reason: Against the unchanged independent Joudioux interpolation-space trace target, after quantifies only over timeH1 X T (an X-valued initial datum plus an X-valued L2 derivative) and concludes continuity and a Y-norm bound after an arbitrary continuous linear map. The classical target assumes only L2(X) values with Y-valued weak derivative and concludes continuity in [X,Y]1/2. The after has meaningful computational content but neither provides that interpolation-space conclusion nor covers the classical weaker domain. Therefore this after remains misaligned to the same selected target; no claim of logical falsity or of a negative verdict against a different H1-continuity target.
